craft_evidence.owned: None. Evidence (VF 10-K FY2026): products 'primarily obtained from approximately 216 independent contractor manufacturing facilities in approximately 24 countries'; no owned plants named. The TNF suppliers page refers to 'our cut and sew factories' (claim, unnamed).
craft_evidence.makers: None on the 56 product pages read; the suppliers page names no factory and gives no factory list.
craft_evidence.mills: No mills named. Licensed fabric brands named on pages: GORE-TEX (2L, Pro 3L) and Pertex (Quantum, Y Fuse); also Spectra, YKK AquaGuard, VISLON zips. These are ingredient brands, not mills.
craft_evidence.heritage: Dated and placed, brand's own words: 'In 1966, a young climber named Doug Tompkins used his savings to start a revolution'; 'A humble shop in San Francisco' (our-story page; city only, no street).
craft_evidence.process: Claim-level. Pages give fabric weights, deniers, laminate type and fill power on nearly every style, which documents the materials but not where or how garments are made. No made-in line on any page r
craft_evidence.reasoning: None of the 56 men's product pages read states a country of origin or names a maker or mill; they are specific about fabric spec (denier, g/m², laminate, down fill). VF's FY2026 10-K says production is from ~216 independent contractor facilities in ~24 countries, with no owned plant. The founding is dated and placed (1966, San Francisco), which lifts it off 1.

ownership.owner: VF Corporation (NYSE: VFC), Form 10-K for fiscal year ended 28 Mar 2026
